record.body:
## Rationale

An area is a named, long-lived part of the product, such as dashboard, canon, CLI or skills. Ideas point to one area, and `orchestra view roadmap` groups ideas by area. This is the cheapest meaning that still gives the roadmap a stable grouping.

## Counter-argument

A roadmap lane (now / next / later) answers "what comes next", which a roadmap reader asks first. Product areas do not order anything, so ordering must come from idea status or score milestones instead.

payload.choice: An area is a named, long-lived product area (dashboard, canon, CLI, skills)
